items.caption: EV Tile maps vehicle data by exact technical Ident. MySkoda is the first fully supported source; other vehicle modules can be assigned manually.

items.name: CreateListView
items.caption: Create grouped vehicle view with links
EV Tile creates group instances and links to the original vehicle variables. Links do not receive their own display name or icon; the original variable presentation is used.

For the Tile Visualization, configure the EV Tile object as Single element and select Vehicle. This visualization setting is stored by Symcon in the visualization configuration and cannot be preset by the module.

Creates a native Symcon line chart once: state of charge and charging limit on the left axis, charging power on the right axis. The source variables must be logged in Archive Control for history to be visible.
